case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading R. Shaji v. State of Kerala.

number_of_accused.correct_value: Charge sheet against five persons; trial conducted against two (A-1 and A-2)
number_of_accused.quote: charge sheet was filed against five persons, including the appellant... trial... could be conducted only against two persons
number_of_accused.reason: Two were tried, but five were charge-sheeted; the value omits this distinction.

accused_gender.reason: Judgment refers to the appellant's wife and uses male pronouns, so male is supported.

accused_age.reason: No age for the appellant appears anywhere in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states the appellant was working as Deputy Superintendent of Police.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status is not stated in the judgment.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record of the appellant is stated; only co-accused's other cases are mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Praveen is referred to as a male (his son, his body, he).

victim_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the deceased Praveen.

victim_caste.reason: Victim caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Victim religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Not stated as spouse; victim had illicit relationship with appellant's wife
accused_victim_relationship.quote: Praveen developed an illicit relationship with the appellant's wife
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Victim was not the spouse; he was the wife's paramour and the appellant's relative is unclear.

offence_category.reason: Case concerns murder under Section 302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Convictions were under ss.302, 120-B, 201 and 364 IPC, as listed.

weapon.reason: Chopper (M.O.4) used for dismemberment is the weapon identified.

evidence_type.reason: Prosecution case was based on circumstantial evidence, with no eyewitness to killing.

confession.correct_value: No confession; disclosure statement by appellant led to recoveries
confession.quote: the appellant made a disclosure statement to the effect that Praveen's body was mutilated using the chopper
confession.reason: No confession is recorded, but the disclosure statement is omitted from the value.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Motive, vehicle use, dismemberment and conspiracy are the circumstances the court treated as proved.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does not discuss any mitigating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted the appellant and sentenced him to life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Criminal Appeal No. 86 of 2006 dismissed; conviction affirmed on 10.12.2009
high_court_outcome.quote: Aggrieved, both of them preferred Criminal.Appeal No. 86 of 2006, which was dismissed by the High Court
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court outcome was dismissal of the appeal, not not-applicable.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, leaving conviction intact.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Murder (s.302), criminal conspiracy (s.120-B), causing disappearance of evidence (s.201), kidnapping for murder (s.364) with s.120-B
offence_finally_established.quote: Section 201 read with Section 120-B IPC... Section 364 read with Section 120-B IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Criminal trespass is not mentioned; s.201 concerns evidence, not a person; the list mischaracterises the offences.

imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment under s.302 is stated.

imprisonment_years.reason: Judgment gives life imprisonment, not a fixed term, so null is appropriate.

fine_rs.correct_value: Rs. 1,00,000 fine on s.302 conviction (default one year SI)
fine_rs.quote: awarded a sentence of life imprisonment and a fine of Rs. one lakh, in default of which, he would undergo SI for a period of one year
fine_rs.reason: A fine of Rs. one lakh was imposed; value wrongly recorded as null.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Prosecution alleged the accused and another conspired to eliminate the victim; the conspiracy was not a neutral established fact at this stage
neutral_facts.quote: The accused and another person were involved in a conspiracy to eliminate the victim.
neutral_facts.reason: Presents the court's contested conclusion on conspiracy as fact, edging toward revealing the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states no statutory penalty range; the 'minimum death' framing is unsupported.

attempt_completion.reason: Murder was completed; victim's body was dismembered and recovered.

physical_harm.reason: Dismemberment of the victim's body is described in the judgment.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Convictions for s.302, s.201, s.364 (each with s.120-B) against the appellant; charge sheet against five persons
number_of_offences.quote: charge sheet was filed against five persons, including the appellant
number_of_offences.reason: Five refers to persons charge-sheeted, not offences charged; offence count is misstated.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed in the judgment.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court found the appellant and A-2 hatched a conspiracy to eliminate the victim.

motive.reason: Court found appellant could not tolerate the victim's intimacy with his wife.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Recoveries, DNA report, post-mortem opinion and disclosure statement are the evidence the court relied on.

witness_credibility.reason: Quality over quantity principle and PW.12 re-appreciation by High Court are both stated.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Appellant's conduct in the van recovery held relevant under s.8; co-accused A-5 absconded
post_offence_conduct.quote: his conduct was relevant under Section 8 of the Evidence Act
post_offence_conduct.reason: Value omits the s.8 conduct point and misattributes the absconding details to the appellant's record.

custody_duration.reason: Custody duration is not stated in the judgment.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not stated in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Sessions judgment 3.1.2006; High Court 10.12.2009; Supreme Court judgment 4 February 2013
trial_duration.reason: Supreme Court date is 4 February 2013; 24.2.2013 is not stated and conflicts with the header.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the appearance listing, minor spelling variation only.

investigation_status.reason: Charge sheet against five, trial against two, and recoveries including DNA report are stated.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Section 164 statements not marked/exhibited; no test identification parade held (defence objections)
procedural_irregularity.quote: The said statements were not put on record before the trial court, and the same were not marked.
procedural_irregularity.reason: Judgment records non-marking of s.164 statements and no TIP; 'None noted' is contradicted.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court dismissal and Supreme Court dismissal are accurately listed.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches prosecution's motive and circumstantial evidence argument in the judgment.

defence_argument.reason: Matches defence grounds on motive, TIP, s.164 statements and blood group.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Circumstantial evidence and beyond reasonable doubt principles are applied in the judgment.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All listed authorities appear in the judgment, though the list is not exhaustive.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives no sentencing rationale; it addresses conviction and affirms the sentence only.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are discussed in the judgment.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No sentencing aggravating factors are expressly identified by the court.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: s.201: 3 years and Rs.2,000 fine; s.364: 7 years RI and Rs.5,000 fine; all sentences concurrent
other_sentence_order.quote: All the sentences were directed to run concurrently.
other_sentence_order.reason: Other sentences and fines under ss.201 and 364 were imposed; value wrongly says none.
